s: January 9, 2026 - The Dukars were a group of Serôsian wizards who used coral implants to channel their magic. Their goal was the protection of Serôs from all kinds of menaces and to promote peace and harmony between all races.[1] The dukars were divided into five orders: Nantari, Jhimar, Kupav, Maalirn, and Numos.[2] Furthermore, two different dukar paths existed: the lorekeeper and the peacekeeper.[1] The order of Nantari was destroyed in early fighting between the orders[3] and the order of Jhimar died out...
